title: Causal Interventions Reveal Typologically Organized Syntactic Mechanisms in Multilingual Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.28924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linguistic theory has long recognized cross-linguistic syntactic regularities, leading to claims that these similar structures are processed by similar mechanisms. However, this hypothesis has been difficult to test empirically due to our lack of fine-grained, manipulable access of human processing mechanisms. In this work, we take advantage of techniques from mechanistic interpretability to study such a question in multilingual LMs. We first isolate language-internal mechanisms before attempting to transfer them cross-lingually. Across four models and three well-studied constructions (subject--verb number agreement, anaphoric pronoun gender agreement, and filler--gap object extraction) we find consistent cross-lingual mechanism transfer. translated_title: 因果干预揭示多语言语言模型中按类型学组织的句法机制
translated_abstract: 语言理论早已认识到跨语言的句法规律性，并由此提出这些相似结构由相似机制处理的论断。然而，由于我们缺乏对人类处理机制进行细粒度、可操控研究的手段，这一假设一直难以通过实证加以检验。在本工作中，我们利用机制可解释性技术，在多语言语言模型中研究这一问题。我们首先分离语言内部的机制，然后尝试将其进行跨语言迁移。在四个模型和三种被充分研究的句法结构（主谓数一致、回指代词性一致以及填充词-空位宾语提取）上，我们发现了一致的跨语言机制迁移。我们进一步发现这种迁移是分级的，在类型学上更相似的语言之间迁移程度更高。我们相信我们的工作为跨语言句法结构和多语言模型机制提供了新的假设。
tldr: 本工作通过因果干预技术在多语言语言模型中发现句法处理机制可以跨语言迁移，且语言之间类型学相似度越高，机制迁移程度越大。
en_tdlr: This work uses causal interventions in multilingual language models to show that syntactic processing mechanisms transfer across languages, with greater transfer observed between typologically more similar languages.
